metadataRaw.title: How to Fix Hamstring Cramps in SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve hamstring tightness and pain.

The hamstrings are a group of muscles on the back of the thigh. When strained or inflamed, they can cause discomfort that radiates from the upper leg down toward the knee.

A common cause is tightness and weakness in the hamstrings and their supporting muscles. That’s why these exercises focus on both lengthening and strengthening to provide fast relief—and help prevent the pain from coming back.

For best results, go through all of the exercises and stick with the ones that give you the most relief.

Best of all, these moves can be done at home, require no equipment, and may ease hamstring pain in as little as 30 seconds!

Watch now and start fixing hamstring pain for good!
